column1: Clause    2 :  This  clause  amends  section  5  of  the  Carriage  by  Air  Act  and  the  legal  effect
of  the  section  as  amended  is  to  provide  for  the  Minister  to  specify  the  limits  of  liability  for
domestic  carriage  by  air,  whereby  the  higher  threshold  applicable  to  the  limits  of  liability
for  international  carriage  by  air  will  not  be  applicable  to  domestic  carriage  by  air.
